title: What Broadcom (AVGO)'s Extended Apple Custom Chip Deal Through 2031 Means For Shareholders
title_zh: Broadcom (AVGO) 将苹果定制芯片交易延长至 2031 年对股东意味着什么
summary: In early July 2026, Broadcom Inc. announced that it and Apple Inc. had expanded their long-running technology collaboration through 2031 with new multi-year agreements for Broadcom to develop and supply custom ASIC silicon across multiple generations of Apple products.
summary_zh: 2026 年 7 月上旬，博通公司 (Broadcom Inc.) 宣布，其与苹果公司 (Apple Inc.) 已将长期技术合作范围扩大到 2031 年，并签署了新的多年协议，让博通 (Broadcom) 为多代苹果产品开发和供应定制 ASIC 芯片。

title: ORCL Stock At 14-Month Low Amid High Debt, Execution Risks: Retail Calls $300B OpenAI Deal A 'Liability'
title_zh: ORCL 股价处于 14 个月低点，债务高企，执行风险：散户称 300B 美元的 OpenAI 交易是“负债”
summary: Oracle shares tumbled 6.5% on Monday amid a market-wide sell-off triggered by the escalation of the war in Iran.
summary_zh: 由于伊朗战争升级引发全市场抛售，甲骨文股价周一暴跌 6.5%。

title: KKR (KKR) On Korea Renewables Deal While Fair Value Views Still Split
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 关于韩国可再生能源交易，但公允价值观点仍存在分歧
summary: KKR (KKR) is back in focus after agreeing with SK Inc. to form a large Korean renewable energy platform valued at about US$1.3b, consolidating solar, wind and fuel cell assets into a single operator. See our latest analysis for KKR.
summary_zh: KKR (KKR) 与 SK Inc. 达成协议，组建一个价值约 1.3 亿美元的大型韩国可再生能源平台，将太阳能、风能和燃料电池资产整合到一家运营商后，KKR (KKR) 重新成为人们关注的焦点。请参阅我们对 KKR 的最新分析。

title: HSBC Weighs Turkey Exit as Emirates NBD Explores Acquisition Deal
title_zh: 阿联酋国民银行 (Emirates NBD) 探索收购交易，汇丰银行考虑退出土耳其
summary: HSBC is reportedly exploring a sale of its Turkey business to Emirates NBD, extending its global restructuring while sharpening its focus on core growth markets.
summary_zh: 据报道，汇丰银行正在考虑将其土耳其业务出售给阿联酋国民银行，以扩大其全球重组，同时加强对核心增长市场的关注。
